# Off-GPU inventory

**GPU 100% target: every site below ticked off, nothing off the GPU.**

Generated by `node scripts/off-gpu-scan.mjs --doc` (`npm run offgpu`); do not edit by hand. The checklist at the end is regenerated from the scan, so a site leaves it when it moves to the GPU.
No percentage blocks a push or a deploy; the honest score is printed and the target is 100%. What each category means is at the top of the script.

**888/5014 on GPU (17% honest, counting 614 class-write and timer/observer sites; target 100%), 4126 off: frame path 2387, during use 1731, no caller found 8; 198 setup sites left out of the count and listed; 2051 tagged run-once/rare allocations (// alloc-rare: reason) also left out, listed with their reasons; per-frame view (event-only sites set aside): 888/3283 on GPU (27%), 1731 event-only sites listed apart (timer or rest pass 494, stored callback 320, event handler 293, promise 264, observer 172, store or registry listener 136, event or timer 21, a method of this name is called from timer or rest pass 21, motion handler 6, a method of this name is called from store or registry listener 3, a method of this name is called from event handler 1)**.

**Warm garbage: 132829 B/frame over 6 frame functions** (compiled, in node; `npm run warm`), all within their limits. stage frame with the vessels (stage.js + veins-gl.js, 60 Hz display, 30 Hz model) 132406 B; blood.advanceStream, 40 streams 229 B; pressure-time ingest (real engine frames) 188 B; flow-rows changedRows + retireRows + flowClose 2 B; uniform-cache, a frame of fifty uniforms 2 B; veins-bin splitCells into a kept record 2 B.
